_about: Proposed voicebanks[] and vocoders[] for https://resonance.plok.org/index.json (vocal-mcp-control-and-quality.md §5). Merge into the served index next to drumkits[]; the server copy is the live one. url is always the creator's own download — never rehost. Verified 2026-10-07 with the GitHub releases API (gh api repos/<repo>/releases/tags/<tag>): url, bytes and, where GitHub publishes an asset digest, sha256. Terms, credit and commercial come from docs/history/research/singing-voicebank-options-2026-notes/. Fields under _unverified were not checked against a primary source. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the app.

_unverified.sha256: GitHub publishes no digest for this 2024 asset; download and hash it before publishing (sha256sum TIGER_DS_v106_PACK.zip), or leave it out and the download is not verified
_unverified.credit: the exact credit wording is in the TOS at tigermeat.xyz, which the research did not retrieve
_unverified.layout: whether the PACK zip holds the bank folder alone (the installer strips one wrapper and drops files outside the dsconfig.yaml branch) was not checked

_unverified.terms: the ToU forbids use 'in AI-generated music and other generative AI contexts' and asks porters to contact the creator; D9 accepts this while Resonance is not commercial — revisit before any commercial release

_unverified.changes: the v170 release notes are empty; what changed from the v160 Resonance shipped (sound, phonemes, layout) is unknown

_unverified.package: the .oudep is OpenUtau's dependency package (a zip holding vocoder.yaml and the ONNX model); its inner layout was not inspected — the installer accepts vocoder.yaml at the top or one folder down

_unverified.sha256: GitHub publishes no digest for this asset; hash it before publishing
_unverified.package: inner layout of the .oudep not inspected

_not_listed.tgm_hifigan: tigermeat's vocoder (TIGER bundles r03, Meiji bundles v110). No standalone download URL or terms were found; all three banks above ship their own vocoder, so none needs it from the index.
